meta.title: Freebies — Free Small-Business Tools
meta.subtitle: Invoicing, bookkeeping, scheduling, and contracts — free tools for small businesses, authors, and resellers.
meta.note: Costs and plan limits change over time; check each official site before signing up. Listings are educational and are not legal, tax, or medical advice.
meta.noAffiliate: No affiliate links. Every link points to the tool's official website.

categories.label: Invoicing
categories.description: Send professional invoices and get paid.

categories.label: Bookkeeping
categories.description: Track income, expenses, and financial reports.

categories.label: Scheduling
categories.description: Let clients book appointments without back-and-forth email.

tools.name: Wave Invoicing
tools.description: Unlimited free invoicing with customizable templates and payment tracking.
tools.cost: Free — unlimited invoices; fees only if you accept online payments
steps: Create a free Wave account.
Add your business name, address, and logo.
Create a new invoice, add your customer and line items.
Send by email or share a payment link.
Mark invoices as paid and view reports in your dashboard.

tools.name: Zoho Invoice
tools.description: Free online invoicing for small businesses, with estimates, time tracking, and a client portal.
tools.cost: Free for small businesses; unlimited invoices
steps: Sign up for a free Zoho Invoice account.
Set up your organization and invoice template.
Add a customer.
Create and send an invoice (or estimate).
Track payment status and send reminders.

tools.name: Invoice Ninja
tools.description: Open-source invoicing, expenses, and payments. Free to self-host; paid cloud plans available.
tools.cost: Free to self-host; paid cloud plans
steps: Sign up for the cloud free tier, or self-host with Docker.
Add your company details and logo.
Create a client record.
Create an invoice and send it.
Record payments when received.

tools.name: Square Invoices
tools.description: Send invoices from your phone or computer. Free to send; standard card processing fees apply when customers pay.
tools.cost: Free to send; processing fees apply to paid invoices
steps: Sign up for a Square account.
Go to Invoices and create an invoice.
Add your customer, items, and due date.
Send by email or text message.
Track payments in your Square Dashboard.

tools.name: PayPal Invoicing
tools.description: Create and send invoices through PayPal. Free to send; fees apply when the customer pays.
tools.cost: Free to create and send; payment processing fees apply
steps: Log in to PayPal and go to Invoicing.
Click Create invoice.
Add your customer and items; set tax or discount.
Preview and send the invoice.
Track payments in Activity.

tools.name: Wave Accounting
tools.description: Free accounting software for small businesses: income and expense tracking, receipt scanning, and basic reports.
tools.cost: Free accounting; fees for payments and payroll add-ons
steps: Create a free Wave account.
Set up your chart of accounts (or keep the defaults).
Import transactions or connect your bank (optional).
Categorize income and expenses.
Run Profit & Loss and other reports.

tools.name: GnuCash
tools.description: Free, open-source desktop accounting with double-entry bookkeeping, for personal and small-business use.
steps: Download and install GnuCash for your system.
Create a new file and set up your accounts.
Enter income and expenses as transactions.
Reconcile accounts against your statements.
Run reports such as Profit & Loss.

tools.name: Manager.io
tools.description: Free desktop accounting for one business, with invoicing, bills, inventory, and reports.
tools.cost: Free desktop edition (one business); cloud edition is paid
steps: Download the free desktop edition.
Create a new business file.
Set up your chart of accounts and tax codes.
Record sales, purchases, and payments.
Generate financial reports.

tools.name: Google Sheets
tools.description: Free spreadsheets you can use as a simple income and expense ledger. Start blank or use a bookkeeping template.
steps: Open Google Sheets and start a new spreadsheet (or choose a budget template).
Create columns for date, description, category, income, and expense.
Log each transaction.
Use SUM formulas to total by category.
Reconcile against your bank statement monthly.

tools.name: NCH Express Accounts
tools.description: Free accounting software for small businesses with fewer than five employees.
tools.cost: Free for businesses with fewer than five employees
steps: Download and install the free edition.
Set up your company and accounts.
Enter sales, payments, and expenses.
Run financial reports.
Back up your data file regularly.

tools.name: Calendly
tools.description: Appointment scheduling that lets clients pick a time on your calendar. Free tier includes one event type.
tools.cost: Free tier (one event type); paid plans add more
steps: Create a free Calendly account.
Connect your calendar (Google, Outlook, etc.).
Set your availability hours.
Create an event type (for example, consultation).
Share your booking link with clients.

tools.name: Setmore
tools.description: Free online appointment scheduling with a customizable booking page and reminders.
tools.cost: Free tier available; paid plans for more staff and features
steps: Sign up for a free Setmore account.
Add your services and staff.
Set your business hours and availability.
Customize your booking page.
Share the booking link or embed it on your site.

tools.name: Google Calendar
tools.description: Free calendar for scheduling appointments, blocking time, and sharing availability with clients.
steps: Open Google Calendar.
Create an event and add your client as a guest.
Set the date, time, and reminders.
Add a video call or location (optional).
Save and send the invitation.

tools.name: SimplyMeet
tools.description: Free meeting scheduling with a personal booking page and calendar sync.
tools.cost: Free tier available; paid plans for more event types
steps: Create a free SimplyMeet account.
Connect your calendar.
Set your availability.
Create a meeting type.
Share your booking link.

tools.name: Dropbox Sign
tools.description: E-signatures for contracts and agreements. Free tier allows three signature requests per month.
tools.cost: Free tier: 3 signature requests per month; paid plans for more
steps: Create a free Dropbox Sign account.
Upload your contract.
Add signature and date fields.
Add signer email addresses.
Send for signature and track status.

tools.name: PandaDoc
tools.description: Document builder and e-signature platform for proposals, contracts, and quotes.
tools.cost: Free tier available; paid plans for advanced features
steps: Create a free PandaDoc account.
Upload a contract or choose a template.
Add signature, date, and text fields.
Send to the client for signature.
Track when it is opened and signed.

tools.name: Jotform Sign
tools.description: Turn forms into signable documents. Free Starter plan includes 5 forms and 100 submissions per month.
tools.cost: Free tier available (Starter: 5 forms / 100 submissions per month)
steps: Create a free Jotform account.
Build a document or upload a PDF.
Add signature fields.
Publish and share the signing link.
Collect and download signed copies.

tools.name: SignWell
tools.description: Simple e-signatures for contracts. Free tier allows three documents per month.
tools.cost: Free tier: 3 documents per month; paid plans for unlimited
steps: Create a free SignWell account.
Upload your document.
Add signers and signature fields.
Send for signature.
Download the executed contract and audit trail.

tools.name: Signaturely
tools.description: Free e-signature tool for contracts and agreements.
tools.cost: Free tier: 3 signature requests per month
steps: Create a free Signaturely account.
Upload your contract.
Add signature and date fields and signers.
Send for signature.
Store and download the completed document.
